Strategy: Save room for a triple-size item. A leftover that fits an item three times this size stays valuable for big arrivals, while one just below it is far less useful. Score by leftover with a bonus at three times the item size, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a bin preserving triple-size room. Exact fits rank top. It may help by keeping very-big-item capacity, but may fail by wasting loose bins when very big items never come.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item if r - item >= item * 3 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Triple-size usability bonus: +item when post-placement leftover >= 3*item.
